_note: Shared agent.json defaults for the RAINMOJO SO plugin. Every skill's agent.json inherits these. A skill's own agent.json only needs its unique metadata and workflow; merge these keys in (skill-level values override). Mirrors the conventions in _base/skill-scaffold.md.

brand_loading._note: Skills auto-load client brand context before executing; see Brand Context in _base/skill-scaffold.md.
brand_loading.on_found: Load and apply brand voice, tone, and context.

output_convention._note: Shared naming and save-location rules; see Output in _base/skill-scaffold.md.

subfolders.content/planning: content calendars, roadmaps, topic plans, and batch manifests
subfolders.content/production/{slug}: stateful article packages and per-article reports
subfolders.content/dashboards: regenerated mutable current content and publishing views only
subfolders.content/reports/status: immutable run-scoped content status snapshots and batch manifests
subfolders.content/reports/publishing: immutable run-scoped WordPress draft publishing snapshots
subfolders.disavow/data/decision-ledgers: immutable dated and run-scoped disavow decisions
subfolders.disavow/reports/reviews: immutable dated and run-scoped disavow review evidence
subfolders.disavow/dashboards: regenerated mutable current disavow view only
subfolders.disavow/exports/search-console: immutable dated and run-scoped Search Console disavow candidates
subfolders.reports/data: unified-report inputs and working JSON only
subfolders.reports/seo-audits: SEO, AISO, technical, and combined search audits
subfolders.optimization: general meta tags and technical recommendations
subfolders.optimization/images: image-optimization outputs and naming ledgers outside article packages

workspace_routing.before_write: Resolve the most precise existing route and write only to the returned client-confined path.
workspace_routing.novel_work_policy: Use create-work only when no existing route reasonably fits; require owner, artifact_classes, writable_subpaths, source_of_truth, retention, description, and created_at. After registration, resolve every artifact with route-work and write only to its returned target; never construct a work path directly. An explicit external source_of_truth must already exist, otherwise use the generated work README. Append log.md.
workspace_routing.containment_policy: Reject absolute paths, traversal, symlinks, junctions, reparse points, and any path outside the real client root.
workspace_routing.closeout: Run client_workspace.py validate after structural changes and before handoff.

content_rules._priority: MANDATORY - overrides any conflicting guidance in a skill file.
content_rules.title_tag_brand_policy: Include the brand or site name ONLY in the homepage title tag (as the first element). For ALL non-homepage pages (service, product, category, blog, about, contact, trust and credibility, local, informational) do NOT include the brand name and do NOT append a '|' brand separator. Use the full character budget for topic, keywords, and context. Reason: Google already shows the Sitename in the SERP, so a brand in the title wastes space.

title_examples.wrong: บริการรับทำ SEO เพิ่มยอดขาย ติดอันดับ | BIQDADDY
title_examples.right: บริการรับทำ SEO เพิ่มยอดขาย ติดอันดับ และรองรับ AI Search

content_rules.forbidden_characters_in_output: Do NOT use an em dash or the pipe character '|' in generated title tags, meta descriptions, headings, or body content and recommendations. Use commas, spaces, the word และ, or rephrase. Markdown table delimiters are exempt as structural formatting.
content_rules.no_emoji: Do NOT use emoji in client-facing deliverables.
content_rules.no_ai_writing_patterns: Avoid filler AI patterns: no สรุป section headers, no ฉบับสมบูรณ์ labels, no decorative emoji.
